title: Trapping Rain Water
statement_md: Given `n` non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is `1`, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

hints.text: Water trapped above bar i is min(max_left, max_right) - height[i].
Two pointers from left and right can eliminate O(n) prefix/suffix arrays.
If left_max < right_max, process left pointer and increment; otherwise process right pointer and decrement.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Two Pointers
Converging pointers from left and right maintaining `left_max` and `right_max`.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(n)$
- **Space Complexity:** $O(1)$
